name: Shipping Corporation of India Land and Assets Limited

facts.business: Shipping Corporation of India Land and Assets Limited (SCILAL) owns and manages a portfolio of residential and commercial real estate properties in Mumbai and Kolkata, and operates a Maritime Training Institute (MTI) offering pre-sea, post-sea, and value-added courses for seafarers.

capacity_or_capex.item: 515.5 kWp Grid connected Roof Top Solar Power Plant at MTI
capacity_or_capex.timeline: Completed (1st Green Campus in Indian Maritime Education Industry)

capacity_or_capex.item: Upgrade of GMDSS GOC Course software
Upgrade of Computer Laboratory with new Laptops

key_risks: Market fluctuations, changing regulatory policies, and increasing competition from private developers may impact occupancy and rental yields
Rising maintenance costs and regulatory approvals may delay asset monetization and redevelopment
Non-availability of in-house workshop facilities for GME and ETO courses creates operational dependency on external service providers
IT infrastructure has less capacity to adequately support training requirements
Board composition non-compliance with SEBI LODR and Companies Act requirements (lack of independent directors, woman director, proper committee constitution)
facts.related_party_note: Trade receivables include receivables from related parties (refer note 31)
